summary: Accept a test helper group in the plan check
pull_request_body: Issue #3462: the rule that landed with #3433 refuses a valid `other` group that changes only a test helper or a fixture, so a planner cannot plan a helper-only group. The rule must accept that group and keep the refusal for a group that changes only test modules and names no test function.
why: Issue #3462: the rule that landed with #3433 refuses a valid `other` group that changes only a test helper or a fixture, so a planner cannot plan a helper-only group. The rule must accept that group and keep the refusal for a group that changes only test modules and names no test function.
what_changes: `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py` judges only an `other` group whose every changed path is under `tests/` and is a test module, so a group that changes a test helper or a fixture is accepted.

The rule decides the test-module form with the public `is_test_module` of the core test selection module. The test selector of `devops ci test <paths>` and the coverage index already share that function, so the plan check and the selector agree on which file is a test module.
`tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py` gains the case of a helper group, the case of a path-only refusal and a self-acceptance case with a name of its own.
The change carries a spec delta on `roadmap-stage`, because the plan check is behavior that a consumer observes.
feasibility: The probe confirms the helper path that the issue cites: The path `tests/support/builders.py` is a file of the staging commit.

The probe moves the test path that the issue cites: The path `tests/roadmap/test_roadmap_stage_content.py` is no file at the root of the staging commit. These files of the commit are candidates: `tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py`. Commit bff2f14fd 2026-11-06 refactor(roadmap): group the job modules in subpackages (#3897) deleted or renamed it.

The probe moves the source path the same way: The path `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage_change.py` is no file at the root of the staging commit. These files of the commit are candidates: `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py`. Commit bff2f14fd 2026-11-06 refactor(roadmap): group the job modules in subpackages (#3897) deleted or renamed it.

The rule of #3433 is in the staged tree, so this change narrows it: `search_code` for `_test_only_group_problems` returned `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py:1457:def _test_only_group_problems(proposal: StageProposal) -> list[str]:` and `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py:1675:problems.extend(_test_only_group_problems(proposal))`.

`read_file` of `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py` showed the condition that the plan changes: `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py:1466:p.startswith("tests/") and not p.startswith("tests/fixtures/")`.
`read_file` of the same file showed that a code span that holds only a path stays refused: `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py:1453:segment = span.strip().rsplit("::", 1)[-1]`.

`src/devops_cli/core/test_selection.py:314:def is_test_module(path: Path | str) -> bool:` is public, and its docstring names it the one test that the selector, the coverage index and `devops ci test` share. It is true for a base name with the prefix `test_` and the suffix `.py`. `src/devops_cli/roadmap/implement/implement_scoped_ci.py:41` and `src/devops_cli/core/coverage_index.py:49` import it already.

Two private predicates of the same form exist in the stage package: `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_paths.py:311:def _is_test_module(path: str) -> bool:` also takes the pytest pattern `*_test.py`, and `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_form.py:147:def _is_test_module(path: PurePosixPath) -> bool:` tests the `test_` prefix. The repository holds no `*_test.py` file.
`src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py:200:_PLAN_CHECK_FILE: Final[str] = "src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py"` names the file whose change needs the self-acceptance test.

`src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py:255:STAGE_EVAL_TRIGGER_PATHS: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = (` holds `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py`, so the plan runs the replay; `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py:264:STAGE_EVAL_REPLAY: Final[str] = "uv run devops roadmap eval stage --replay"` gives the command of the score task; and `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py:272:_FAILS_ON_BASE: Final[str] = "fails on the base"` gives the phrase that the gate test holds.

The existing cases that the plan keeps: `tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py:765:def test_a_test_only_other_group_with_no_named_test_is_refused() -> None:` is the conditional case, and `tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py:853:def test_content_problems_accepts_this_plans_own_proposal() -> None:` already builds the #3266 plan's own proposal, so the new self-acceptance case takes a name of its own.
The plan answers the reported fault: no What Changes item names a fixture folder, because the rule drops that exclusion and judges every group path by the test-module test alone.
`_test_only_group_problems` and `is_test_module` are pure functions of a proposal and of a path, so neither call needs a checkout of the repository, a client of a service or a network.

The verify command `uv run devops ci test tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py` runs `uv`, `devops` and `pytest`, each a runner tool of the image. It needs no network. The pod runs as a non-root user with a read-only root filesystem, so pytest writes its temporary files under `/tmp`.

The replay command `uv run devops roadmap eval stage --replay` needs a checkout of the repository at the base commit and at the change, because it replays the recorded golden cases against the staged tree.
existing_tool: No open, maintained tool covers the need: the rule compares the free text of one stage plan with the paths that a group changes, and no linter, schema or test framework checks that. The change reuses the existing `is_test_module` of `src/devops_cli/core/test_selection.py` and adds no predicate. It narrows `_test_only_group_problems` at a cost of about 10k tokens to build, 5k tokens to keep and about 1 hour of elapsed time. It deletes no internal code.

decisions.decision: Judge only an `other` group whose every changed path is a test module under `tests/`
decisions.reason: A helper and a fixture are no test cases, so the rule cannot ask such a group for the test function that it updates; a group with one path that is no test module is accepted, as the issue asks.

decisions.decision: Reuse `is_test_module` of `src/devops_cli/core/test_selection.py` and keep the `tests/` prefix in the rule
decisions.reason: It is public, and the test selector of `devops ci test <paths>` and the coverage index share it. The plan check and the selector then agree on which file is a test module, and the change adds no predicate.

decisions.decision: Drop the exclusion of fixture paths from the rule
decisions.reason: A fixture or a data file under `tests/` is no test module, so the new condition already accepts a group that changes it, and the exclusion repeated the same test.
It names the group and the missing test function, and a refused group still changes only test modules, so a second key would repeat the same text.
The stage job and the replay both call `content_problems` through `check_proposal`, so one rule set judges both.

decisions.decision: Add the self-acceptance case under a name of its own
decisions.reason: `test_content_problems_accepts_this_plans_own_proposal` already builds the #3266 plan's proposal, so a second function of that name would shadow it.

rejected.alternative: Treat every Python file under `tests/` as a test module
rejected.evidence: `tests/support/builders.py` is a Python file under `tests/`, so that rule refuses the helper group that the issue must accept.

rejected.alternative: Match a `test_` substring in the implementation
rejected.evidence: A code span that holds only `tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py` contains `test_`, so the group would pass with no function; `_is_test_function_span` matches the last `::` segment instead.

The package would then hold two public functions of that name with different rules, because that predicate also takes `*_test.py`, which the selector of `devops ci test <paths>` does not map as a test module. The repository holds no `*_test.py` file, so the wider pattern changes no verdict on this tree.
It is private to the form checks and takes a `PurePosixPath`, and the public `is_test_module` of the core applies the same `test_` prefix test.
`src/devops_cli/lang/en/messages.py:3902:stage_problem_test_only: str = (` already names the group and the missing test function, so a second key duplicates the text.

`tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py:853:def test_content_problems_accepts_this_plans_own_proposal() -> None:` builds the #3266 plan's own proposal, so updating it in place would drop that self-acceptance case; the plan adds a case with a name of its own.

rejected.alternative: Keep the exclusion of fixture paths from the rule
rejected.evidence: A fixture path is no test module, so the new condition already accepts a group that changes it, and the exclusion states the same form twice.

modified.name: A test-only other group names its test function
modified.text: The stage plan SHALL refuse an other task group that changes only test modules under tests and whose implementation names no test function in a code span. The stage plan SHALL accept an other group with one changed path that is no test module under tests. A test module under tests is a path under `tests/` whose base name starts with `test_` and ends with `.py`. A code span names a test function when its last segment starts with `test_`, with optional parentheses. The last segment of a span that holds `::` is the text after the last `::`.

scenarios.name: Conditional test-only group
scenarios.when: `content_problems` reads a proposal with an other group whose `changes` lists only `tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py` and whose `implementation` holds no code span with a `test_` function
scenarios.then: the returned problems hold the refusal sentence for that group

scenarios.name: Named test function
scenarios.when: `content_problems` reads a proposal with an other group whose `changes` lists only `tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py` and whose `implementation` holds a code span with `test_conditional_group`
scenarios.then: the returned problems hold no refusal sentence for that group

scenarios.name: Named test function after a path
scenarios.when: `content_problems` reads a proposal with an other group whose `changes` lists only `tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py` and whose `implementation` holds a code span with `tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py::test_conditional_group`
scenarios.then: the returned problems hold no refusal sentence for that group

scenarios.name: Group with a source path
scenarios.when: `content_problems` reads an other group whose `changes` lists `tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py` and `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py` and whose `implementation` names no test function
scenarios.then: the returned problems hold no refusal sentence for that group

scenarios.name: Refusal names the group
scenarios.when: `content_problems` refuses an other group with the title `Keep the roadmap stage tests green`
scenarios.then: the returned sentence holds `Keep the roadmap stage tests green`

scenarios.name: Test helper group
scenarios.when: `content_problems` reads a proposal with an other group whose `changes` lists only `tests/support/builders.py` and whose `implementation` names no test function
scenarios.then: the returned problems hold no refusal sentence for that group

scenarios.name: Test file path with no function
scenarios.when: `content_problems` reads a proposal with an other group whose `changes` lists only `tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py` and whose `implementation` holds the code span `tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py` and no other code span
scenarios.then: the returned problems hold the refusal sentence for that group

groups.title: Accept a test helper group in the plan check
groups.test: Write `test_a_test_only_other_group_that_changes_a_test_helper_is_accepted` in `tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_content.py` first. It fails on the base because `_test_only_group_problems` of `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py` refuses a group that changes `tests/support/builders.py`. Add `test_a_test_only_other_group_that_names_only_a_test_file_path_is_refused`. Add `test_content_problems_accepts_the_helper_rules_own_proposal`: it builds this plan's own `StageProposal`, calls `content_problems` and asserts that it returns no problem. Keep `test_a_test_only_other_group_with_no_named_test_is_refused` as the conditional case
groups.implementation: Import `is_test_module` from `src/devops_cli/core/test_selection.py` in `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py`. Make `_test_only_group_problems` refuse a group only when every changed path starts with `tests/` and is a test module. Run `uv run devops roadmap eval stage --replay` on the base commit and on the change. State the score before and after the change in the pull request comment
